licensure.disciplinary_grounds.rationale: These nine buckets cleanly partition the dominant ground types: obtaining-credential fraud, practice-level dishonesty/negligence, criminal convictions, reciprocal/inter-jurisdictional discipline, statutory/rule violations, unauthorized practice or title misuse, general fitness/conduct/unprofessional behavior, continuing education and peer review failures, and substance abuse/mental incapacity grounds—together covering essentially all items without over-relying on a catch-all.
